title: Codewars 8kyu: Remove First and Last Character
description: It's pretty straightforward. Your goal is to create a function that removes the first and last characters of a string. You're given one parameter, the original string. You don't have to worry about strings with less than two characters.
solution:
def remove_char(s: str) -> str:
    return s[1:-1]
explanation: String slicing from index 1 to -1 omits boundary characters in O(N) time.
